AggregateConfig.description: Optional rank-based summary of the score components. It is not a probability.
AggregateConfig.title: AggregateConfig

only_qc_passed.description: Run pore geometry and xTB only on structures that passed qc. Set to false to run them on every structure.
only_qc_passed.title: Only Qc Passed

ExportConfig.description: The bundle written by the export: table, records for a viewer, structures, manifest.

include_cifs.description: Copy the structure file of every exported row.
include_cifs.title: Include Cifs

out_dir.description: Folder of the bundle. Default: export/<project>, next to the config file.
out_dir.title: Out Dir

table_format.description: Format of the exported table. parquet needs pyarrow.
table_format.title: Table Format

viewer_bundle.description: Also write the rows as JSON records (candidates.json).
viewer_bundle.title: Viewer Bundle

ExportConfig.title: ExportConfig

building_block_dir.description: Optional folder with extra building blocks in PORMAKE .xyz format.
building_block_dir.title: Building Block Dir

edges.description: PORMAKE edge building blocks, e.g. E14. Leave empty to connect the nodes directly.
edges.title: Edges

linkers.description: Linkers given as SMILES. With two connection points they are used as edges, with three or more as organic nodes, next to the blocks listed in nodes and edges.

max_atoms.description: Skip structures larger than this. null = no limit.
max_atoms.title: Max Atoms

nodes.description: PORMAKE node building blocks, e.g. N16.
nodes.title: Nodes

source.description: 'pormake' assembles structures; 'cifs' reads existing CIF files.
source.title: Source

fallback.description: Settings tried in this order when Zeo++ stops on a structure with high_accuracy. The column zeo_high_accuracy records which setting produced each row. [] = do not retry.
fallback.title: Fallback

high_accuracy.description: Zeo++ high-accuracy Voronoi decomposition (-ha). OCC is the faster setting, DEF the most thorough and much slower on large cells, false turns it off.
high_accuracy.title: High Accuracy

on_missing.description: What to do when enabled is true and the tool is not installed.
on_missing.title: On Missing

probe_radius.description: Probe radius in angstrom for accessible properties.
probe_radius.title: Probe Radius

timeout_minutes.description: Stop an attempt that takes longer than this; the next setting is then tried.
timeout_minutes.title: Timeout Minutes

LinkersConfig.description: Organic linkers given as SMILES and converted to PORMAKE building blocks.

conformers.description: Conformers embedded per linker; the lowest in energy is kept.
conformers.title: Conformers

connection_distance.description: Distance (angstrom) from the anchor atom to the connection point; half a C-C bond.
connection_distance.title: Connection Distance

smiles.description: Linkers written inline, as name: SMILES.
smiles.title: Smiles

smiles_file.description: Text file with one 'SMILES name' pair per line; lines starting with # are ignored.
smiles_file.title: Smiles File

LinkersConfig.title: LinkersConfig

QCConfig.description: Thresholds of the built-in structural checks (distances in angstrom).

bond_factor.description: Multiplier on covalent radii used to detect bonds.
bond_factor.title: Bond Factor

check_composition.description: Formula must equal the sum of the building blocks (when they are known).
check_composition.title: Check Composition

check_valence.description: H needs one neighbour; C needs two to four.
check_valence.title: Check Valence

max_node_rmsd.description: Largest accepted misfit (angstrom) between a node and its vertex in the topology, as reported by PORMAKE. null = do not check.
max_node_rmsd.title: Max Node Rmsd

min_distance.description: No pair of atoms may be closer than this.
min_distance.title: Min Distance

min_distance_heavy.description: No heavy-heavy or H-H pair may be closer than this.
min_distance_heavy.title: Min Distance Heavy

nonbonded_factor.description: Non-bonded contacts must exceed this fraction of the covalent-radius sum.
nonbonded_factor.title: Nonbonded Factor

require_single_framework.description: Reject isolated atoms and extra fragments.
require_single_framework.title: Require Single Framework

QCConfig.title: QCConfig

ToolsConfig.description: Optional explicit paths to external binaries (otherwise they are looked up on PATH).
ToolsConfig.title: ToolsConfig

XtbConfig.description: Semi-empirical electronic proxies (band gap, band edges) from tblite.

max_atoms.description: Structures above this size are skipped, not truncated.
max_atoms.title: Max Atoms

periodic.description: Keep true for frameworks: a finite cluster is a different system.
periodic.title: Periodic

spin.description: Number of unpaired electrons. high_spin: rule of thumb (M(II) high-spin count for Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu). low_spin: none, or one when the electron count is odd.
spin.title: Spin

timeout_minutes.description: Stop a structure that takes longer than this and record it as failed.
timeout_minutes.title: Timeout Minutes

XtbConfig.title: XtbConfig

filter.description: Row filters applied as an explicit step, e.g. 'qc_pass == True'. A row is exported when every filter is true for it.
filter.title: Filter

project.description: Short name of the run; used in file names and the manifest.
project.title: Project

workdir.description: Folder for intermediate tables and structures.
workdir.title: Workdir
